content.text: {"id": "mm6925a1", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Hospitalization was reported by a substantially higher percentage of pregnant women (31.5%) than nonpregnant women (5.8%)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Hospitalization was reported by a substantially higher percentage of pregnant women (31.5%) than nonpregnant women (5.8%)"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Sixteen deaths (0.2%) were reported among 8,207 pregnant women, and 208 (0.2%) were reported among 83,205 nonpregnant women."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among pregnant women, 46.2% were Hispanic, 23.0% were non-Hispanic white (white), 22.1% were non-Hispanic black (black)"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Pregnant women were admitted more frequently to the ICU (1.5%) than were nonpregnant women (0.9%)."}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "After adjusting for age, presence of underlying conditions, and race/ethnicity"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "When stratified by race/ethnicity, ICU admission was most frequently reported among pregnant women who were non-Hispanic Asian (3.5%)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Data on laboratory-confirmed and probable COVID-19 cases † were electronically reported to CDC"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Crude and adjusted risk ratios and 95% CIs for outcomes were calculated using modified Poisson regression."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Risk ratios were adjusted for age (as a continuous variable), presence of underlying chronic conditions (yes/no), and race/ethnicity."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Outcomes with missing data were assumed not to have occurred"}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Cell counts <5 are suppressed."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["study_design"]}
